narrative.en: The evening of July 17th saw the same hook contract—0x96b8...fe0cc—run two identical deals with different tokens. Both pools at zero fee, tick spacing 200. First at block 25548686, second at 25548692. Six blocks apart. Someone clearly testing the mechanics on a couple of different assets, but with the same set of parameters. No liquidity, just initialization. Then the real fireworks hit at block 25548709. One token 0x00009de46ef19cc00580e4855a6e3e4d8bcd8e2c and one hook contract 0x1111...b9000. Ten pools. Ten fee tiers from 1 to 50 basis points. Each with its own tick spacing—from 1 to 1000. Someone fanned the deck. Every possible configuration for one pair. No doubt—this isn't chance, it's a measurement. Someone wanted to see how the router would behave when choosing among ten pools identical in tokens but different in fees. The hooks are likely just collecting statistics or emulating dynamic fees. 81 blocks later, another pattern. Same handwriting, different contract: 0xdf0a...1000. Three pools for token 0x3572...164c. Fees 100, 200, 500. Tick spacings 1, 2, 10. Again a series, again without liquidity. Someone methodically seeding the field. None of these pools have been touched—no swaps, no additions. Pure markup. What is this? Preparation for launching hooks with dynamic rules. Testing routing. Or just someone with a large gas budget deciding to see how many pools can be created in one block. The deck is being shuffled, but the cards haven't been dealt yet.
narrative.zh: 7月17日晚，同一个hooks合约——0x96b8...fe0cc——用两个不同的代币做了两笔一模一样的部署。两个池子都是零费率，tickSpacing 200。第一个在区块25548686，第二个在25548692，相隔六个区块。显然有人在用同一套参数测试不同资产上的机制。没有流动性，只是初始化。真正的烟花在区块25548709绽放。一个代币0x00009de46ef19cc00580e4855a6e3e4d8bcd8e2c和一个hooks合约0x1111...b9000。十个池子。十个从1到50基点的费率档位，每个对应不同的tickSpacing——从1到1000。有人把牌摊开了。同一对代币的所有可能配置。毫无疑问——这不是偶然，是一次测量。有人想看看路由器在面对十个代币相同但费率不同的池子时会如何选择。hooks很可能只是在收集统计数据或模拟动态费率。81个区块后，又一个模式。同样的笔迹，不同的合约：0xdf0a...1000。代币0x3572...164c的三个池子。费率100、200、500。tickSpacing 1、2、10。又是一系列部署，同样没有流动性。有人在有条不紊地播种。这些池子至今无人触碰——没有交换，没有添加。纯粹是标记。这是什么？为启动带动态规则的hooks做准备。测试路由。或者只是某个gas充裕的人想看看一个区块内能创建多少个池子。牌在洗，但还没发。

take.en: A single hook contract is deploying pools in rapid succession, far above the pace of typical deployers.
take.zh: 单个hooks合约正以远超典型部署者的速度连续部署池子。

narrative.en: Three pools on V4, same blockchain range, same hook contract: 0x0d62529346ac2c61f5c0582210d01214687bc0cc. This is not coincidence, it's a pattern. Someone is laying out a deck where the hook isn't just a modifier—it's the centerpiece of the deal. Zero fee, tickSpacing 200—classic setup for high-frequency or specialized liquidity. But with no fee, the pool doesn't live on the spread; it lives on something else. The hook can charge separately, redistribute, alter swap logic—it's a black box. Three pools with the same hook means a strategy is being tested across different pairs. ETH against three tokens, each a small, obscure address: 0xce5fd93f, 0x7d450533, 0x069f0862. None ring a bell. Fresh, likely recently deployed or unwrapped for this specific mechanic. Could be the same deployer stamping pools like cards of one suit. Or a bot auto-creating pairs for a certain hook scenario. Blocks 25540991, 25541114, 25541228—237 blocks between first and last. Not rushed, but rhythmic. No frenzy, just work. Someone is calmly building infrastructure. The question isn't what these tokens are. It's what that hook does. If it manipulates orders, emulates dynamic fees, or hides a liquidation mechanism—that's a new mechanic on the felt. For now, three silent pools. But silence in crypto is often the prelude to a loud hand.
narrative.zh: V4 上三个池子，同一条链，同一个 hook 合约：0x0d62529346ac2c61f5c0582210d01214687bc0cc。这不是巧合，这是布局。有人在摆牌局，hook 不是修饰符，而是牌局的轴心。零费率，tickSpacing 200——高频或特种流动性的经典配置。但没费率，池子不靠价差吃饭，那靠什么？hook 可以单独抽水、重新分配、改变兑换逻辑——这是个黑箱。三个池子用同一个 hook，说明在测试策略，不同对子。ETH 对三个小 token：0xce5fd93f、0x7d450533、0x069f0862，没一个眼熟。新面孔，可能是刚清算完或专为这套机制部署的。也许是同一个庄家在印池子，像印同花色的牌。或者是机器人自动创建对子，套某个 hook 剧本。区块 25540991、25541114、25541228——首尾差 237 个区块。不急不躁，但有节奏。没有喧嚣，只有干活。有人静静地在搭架子。问题不在这些 token 是什么，而在于那个 hook 做什么。如果它能操纵订单、模拟动态费率、或者藏了清算机关——那就是市场里的新招式。眼下只是三个沉默的池子。但在加密江湖，沉默往往是重头戏的前奏。

take.en: Someone is quietly laying down three identical hook-driven pools—this isn't random noise, it's a deliberate setup for a new play.
take.zh: 有人在悄悄布下三个同 hook 的池子——这不是杂音，是蓄谋的新局。

narrative.en: Four fresh deals hit the table last night — all hooks, all V4. The first pool at block 25534390 looked almost classic: two tokens, a fixed fee of 30 basis points, tick spacing of 60. The hook contract at 0xbbe88e sits there, but what it does is anyone's guess. No hook call logs at initialization, so the logic behind it stays face-down. Then came a tight run. Three pools in a row, all with zero fee, all with tick spacing 200 — that's no accident. The second and third pools share the same hook contract, 0x96b893, both with ether as the first token. Feels like someone is rolling out a family of pools under one mechanic — maybe dynamic fees, maybe some averaging strategy. Without a dump of hook events, you're just guessing. The fourth pool at block 25534595 uses a different hook, 0x0d6253. Also ether-based, also zero fee. Eight blocks between the third and fourth — someone worked fast, no pause to think. What sticks: none of these pools have any trade activity at the time of writing. They hang on the chain like blank cards. Hooks without calls are cards dealt but not yet flipped. Makes you wonder if any of these hands will see a first trade, or if they'll only live on as a line in the initialization logs. The V4 deck is growing, but it's a quiet growth. Without events from the hooks, you can't tell who's the ace and who's just filling the seat.
narrative.zh: 昨夜江湖又添四座新池，皆是V4门派，个个带钩。首池生于区块25534390，看似规矩：双币，固定手续费三十基点，步阶六十。钩子藏于0xbbe88e，却不知其用意——开池时无钩子日志，内功心法无从窥探。紧接着三池连出，皆零手续费，步阶二百，绝非巧合。第二、第三池共用一钩，契约0x96b893，皆以以太为基币。看来有人在布阵，同一钩法，或为动态收费，或为某种均值策略。无钩子事件可查，只能揣测。第四池在区块25534595，换了钩子，0x0d6253，仍是以太为基，零手续费。与第三池相隔八块，出手极快，毫无迟疑。引人注意的是，这些池至今无一笔交易。它们悬于链上，如白纸一张。钩子无调用，好比宝剑未出鞘。不知这些池中，谁能等到第一笔买卖，还是终将成为初始化日志里的一行记录。V4江湖在扩张，但只是暗流涌动。钩子不响，难辨谁是真正的高手，谁只是占个位置。

take.en: The house is dealing V4 pools with zero fees and idle hooks — no action yet, but the pattern says someone is building a system, not just flipping tokens.
take.zh: 庄家连开零费池，钩子未动，却已布下阵法——这不是散兵游勇，而是有人在搭台唱戏。

narrative.en: The dealer's hands are moving across the felt. Eleven of today's sixteen pool initializations trace back to a single contract, each one a fresh pair with zero swap fee, tick spacing of 200, and tokens bearing the 0x69 prefix—serial numbers on disposable cards. All pairs use raw ETH, no WETH, no stablecoins. The addresses appear in clusters: first a trio, then a gap, then five more across forty-six blocks. Someone sat on prepared transactions, releasing them when gas dropped. This is not randomness; it's a deliberate setup, a deck being stacked.
narrative.zh: 江湖上今天有异动。十六个新池子里，十一个出自同一门派，手续费全免，tick间距都是200，代币前缀清一色0x69——像是同一批铸出的暗器。这些池子只接纯ETH，不要WETH，也不要USDC、USDT。时间上看，先是三个同区块出现，沉默一阵，又在四十六个区块内连出五个。有人在等gas低的时候分批撒网，不是散兵游勇，是蓄谋已久的布阵。

take.en: Eleven identical zero-fee pools from one factory signal a coordinated play, not organic activity—the house is preparing a liquidity trap or a hook-based revenue scheme.
take.zh: 十一个零手续费池子同出一源，不是散户行为，是有人在搭台子——要么引君入瓮，要么靠钩子抽水。

narrative.en: Two Uniswap V4 pools blink into existence on the same block, then again ten blocks later. Same pair: USDC and USDT. Zero fee, tickSpacing set to one. This is not coincidence. The first hook at 0x858f...6888, the second at 0x457c...888 — different contracts, identical parameters. Someone is dealing two identical pools with different hooks. Why? Perhaps testing behavior: one hook might manage liquidity dynamically, the other something like siphoning fees to itself. But zero fee means it's not about yield. Zero fee on stablecoins is not for trading — it's for something else. Rebalancing, maybe, or arbitrage between the two pools. If the hooks are tuned to different strategies, a price spread between them could be engineered. And someone will be there to catch it. Or it's simply infrastructure deployment for future operations. V4 with hooks offers flexibility — oracles, scheduled swaps, anything. But two copies with the same tokens and zero fee smells like preparation for something specific. Blocks 25519822 and 25519832 — ten blocks apart, about two minutes. Someone sat and waited for the first to confirm before launching the second. Or two addresses acting in sync. For now, it's a hole in the deck — empty pools with no liquidity. But when the money pours in, it will get interesting. Especially if one of the hooks has a trigger for imbalances.
narrative.zh: 两个 Uniswap V4 池子在同一区块里闪亮登场，十块之后又来一对。同样的对子——USDC 和 USDT。零手续费，tickSpacing 设为一。这不是巧合。第一个钩子 0x858f...6888，第二个 0x457c...888——不同合约，相同参数。有人摆下了两个一模一样的池子，却配了不同的钩子。为什么？也许在测试武功：一个钩子可能动态调内力，另一个或许把手续费吸到自己身上。但零手续费，说明不是冲着收益来的。稳定币上零手续费，不是用来交易的——是为了别的。可能是重新平衡，或者两个池子之间的套利。如果钩子各自依不同策略运转，价差就能被人为造出来。而有人会等着抓它。或者，这只是为将来布下的基础设施。V4 的钩子很灵活——可以当预言机，做定时兑换，什么都行。但两个副本，同样的代币，零手续费——闻着像在准备什么特别的活儿。区块 25519822 和 25519832 ——相隔十块，大约两分钟。有人坐着等第一个确认，才启动第二个。或者两个地址在同步出手。眼下，这只是牌桌上一道裂缝——空池子，没有流动性。但等资金涌入，就有好戏看了。尤其如果其中一个钩子藏着触发失衡的机关。

take.en: Zero-fee stable pools with identical parameters but different hooks are a deliberate setup, not a random deployment — someone is preparing the felt for a specific play.
take.zh: 零手续费的稳定币池，参数一致但钩子不同——这不是随机的部署，而是有人在棋盘上摆好了棋子。

narrative.en: Two new pools hit the felt tonight, both V4, both with hooks—but neither carries a single chip of liquidity. The first on Ethereum, block 25512927, pairs native ETH with a token address that smells like a ghost—b792ea99. Zero initial stake, spread of 200 ticks, hooks at 0d6252. The pool ID is long as a losing streak. The second landed on Unichain, block 53064415: WETH paired with contract 6c31e2, a token I've seen in previous deals. Fee set at 8388608—that's no typo, it's a hook-friendly 0.5% precise to eight decimals. Same tick spacing, different hook contract—bc6e5a. The hooks differ between chains, same structure, different logic. That's the tell: someone is laying infrastructure before the game begins. V4 lets hooks intercept swaps before they hit the pool—MEV shields, complex orders, anything. The Unichain pool with WETH and a strange token might be a bridge or cross-chain hook. The Ethereum pool with native ETH and an unknown token is a classic liquidity trap. But without a single transaction, these are just two entries in the log. Watch the hooks. If they start moving, a deal is being set up. For now, silence. But silence before the storm is the loudest sound at the table.
narrative.zh: 昨夜江湖风平浪静，但暗流已在链上涌动。两张新牌翻在桌上——都是V4版本，都带着钩子，却无分文内力。第一张落在以太坊，区块25512927：原生币配一个来路不明的地址b792ea99，初始赌注为零，价差200跳，钩子挂在0d6252。池子ID长得像我的失眠夜。第二张去了Unichain，区块53064415：WETH配合约6c31e2，这令牌我在别的分派中见过。手续费8388608——不是笔误，是钩子友好的0.5%，精确到八位小数。相同的跳距，不同的钩子合约bc6e5a。两条链上钩子不同，结构一样，逻辑却分道扬镳。这不是巧合，是有人在提前布阵。V4的钩子能在交易进池前截胡——MEV护盾、复杂订单，什么都可能。Unichain那池子WETH配怪令牌，许是想搭桥或做跨链钩。以太坊那池子原生币配无名令牌，是经典的吸内力陷阱。但至今没有一笔交易，不过是日志里的两行字。盯紧钩子。若它们开始动弹，便是有人要起牌了。眼下只有寂静。可暴风雨前的寂静，最是震耳欲聋。

take.en: Two V4 pools with hooks and zero liquidity are infrastructure plays, not trades—someone is building a hidden strategy.
take.zh: 两个V4池子带钩子却无流动性，是布阵而非交易——有人在暗处织网。

narrative.en: The deck dealt nine fresh cards tonight, and every one bears the hook brand. Uniswap V4 is gathering steam, and if you're not watching the hooks, you're just staring at the table without seeing who's marked the cards. The first two pools are classic: WETH against USDT and USDC. Zero fee, tick spacing of one. This isn't trading in the usual sense—it's infrastructure. The hook contracts at 0xbf2...888 and 0x495...888 keep their logic hidden, but the mere fact that someone seeds zero-fee pairs with blue chips says one thing: they're here to build volume, not to earn on the spread. Then comes the meat. Pool 0x43e...9922 versus 0xd1b...bb5 with a fee of 100—this is no joke. Hook 0xc24...888, and the pair is clearly non-mainstream. Someone is pooling liquidity for a specific strategy, maybe an order book or dynamic fees. Next, three pools in a row with USDC paired against different tokens. 0x52c...8a0, 0x09a...599, all with fee 100. Hooks—0xc28...888, 0xc23...888. Notice the pattern: hook addresses ending in 888. That's no accident. Either the same deployer or the same factory. Repetition hints at a system, not a one-off. The sixth pool—0x38e...a6a versus 0x98a...665. Fee 100, hook 0xc23...888. Again 888. Again a strange pair. Seventh—WETH against USDT, zero fee, hook 0xc2e...888. Eighth—0x1ab...33c versus 0x888...e51. Fee 100. And ninth—0xc0c...ddf versus USDT, fee 200, hook 0xc21...888. Nine pools. Eight hooks with suffix 888. One with 0xbf2...888. Seven pairs with USDC or USDT. Two zero-fee pools. The felt is laid out. The house is dealing hooks. Watch the cards.
narrative.zh: 昨夜江湖又起波澜，九张新牌落桌，张张带钩。Uniswap V4 门派正在暗中蓄力，若不盯紧这些钩子，你便只是看客，不知牌局已被做了手脚。头两池是经典对局：WETH 对 USDT 与 USDC，分文不取，步距为一。这非寻常交易，而是根基。钩子合约 0xbf2...888 与 0x495...888 的招式尚隐于雾中，但有人竟为蓝筹对子设下零费池，用意昭然：他们要的是量，而非吃价差。接着便是硬仗。池 0x43e...9922 对 0xd1b...bb5，费率百点，钩子 0xc24...888，对子明显非主流。有人正为特定策略聚拢内力，或许是订单簿或动态费率。随后三池连珠，USDC 对阵不同令牌，费率皆百点，钩子 0xc28...888、0xc23...888。留意那规律：钩子地址皆以 888 收尾。绝非偶然。要么同一人部署，要么同出一门。重复意味着体系，而非孤例。第六池——0x38e...a6a 对 0x98a...665，费率百点，钩子 0xc23...888，又是 888，又是怪对。第七池——WETH 对 USDT，零费，钩子 0xc2e...888。第八池——0x1ab...33c 对 0x888...e51，费率百点。第九池——0xc0c...ddf 对 USDT，费率两百，钩子 0xc21...888。九池之中，八钩以 888 结尾，七对涉及 USDC 或 USDT，两池分文不取。棋盘已布，庄家亮钩。看客当心。

take.en: The house is dealing hooks—nine pools, eight with the 888 suffix—and this is not a random deal; it's a systematic build of Uniswap V4 infrastructure, likely by a single entity.
take.zh: 庄家亮钩，九池八钩皆以 888 收尾，绝非散手，而是同一势力在系统性地搭建 Uniswap V4 根基。

narrative.en: Four new V4 pools hit the table last night, all zero-fee. Three of them share the same hook contract—0x627fa6f76fa96b10bae1b6fba280a3c9264500cc—tethered to different tokens. Someone is clearly testing a strategy on ETH pairs with no fee, tick spacing 200. The bet is that order flow alone will generate yield through additional hooks: dynamic fees, MEV protection, or something only the contract sees. The house watches, the cards speak.
narrative.zh: 昨夜江湖新立四座V4分坛，皆设零税。其中三坛共用一个心法口诀——0x627fa6f76fa96b10bae1b6fba280a3c9264500cc，只是换了不同令牌。明眼人一看便知，有人在ETH门派里试水零税策略，步法间距二百。赌的是流水本身能靠暗器——动态税、MEV护体之类——生出内力来。老江湖只看得分，不急着下注。

take.en: The house is laying down zero-fee tables and waiting to see if the action pays off through the hooks—this is the quiet before the real game begins.
take.zh: 零税摆台，暗器生财——这局棋刚落子，胜负还远。

narrative.en: The deck was shuffled tight last night. On Ethereum mainnet, five fresh V4 pools with hooks—and all but one tied to native ETH. A USDC/USDT pair at 0.05% fee and tickSpacing 10—not for speculative churn, but for stablecoins to slide without slippage. The hook contract 0x326a1580… sits there too. And then Uniswap tweets that routing now goes through LitePSM, closing the DAI/USDS/USDC leg into parity. Sky PSM gives hundreds of millions in depth with zero slippage. This isn't news—it's laying the foundation. But the real meat is on Unichain. Hook contract 0x2ea5eac8… loaded pools in batches. Nine pools with the same b3fca863… token. All with fee 8388608—dynamic fee baked into the hook. TickSpacing 60. Same hook, same pattern. Someone is stacking liquidity around one asset, building a concentration layer. And a second hook 0xbc6e5abd…—three more pools, also paired with WETH and the same dynamic fee. On Unichain, these aren't tests—this is a cluster. Separately, a pool on Unichain with ETH and token ea7cb0eb…, fee 100, tickSpacing 1—the tightest possible range. Someone wants to trade with almost no spread. And another pool on mainnet with hook 0x2877bf78…—zero fee, tickSpacing 60, token b44c4eca… against native ETH. Zero fee is either bait for arbitrageurs or an entry into a system where revenue comes from outside the pool fee. Hayden writes about importing Phantom seed phrases into the Uniswap wallet for access to the Robinhood chain. Infrastructure is closing: Phantom users enter the RH order book, and Uniswap routes through PSM. All of it looks like the assembly of a single liquidity layer, where hooks aren't experiments—they're working gears. The deck is laid out.
narrative.zh: 深夜，牌局重新洗过。以太坊主网上五个新V4池子带着钩子——除了一个，全绑着原生ETH。USDC/USDT对，手续费0.05%，tick间距10——不是给投机客玩的，是让稳定币滑点归零。钩子合约0x326a1580…也在那儿。紧接着Uniswap发推说路由走LitePSM，DAI/USDS/USDC这条腿闭合成平价。Sky PSM提供数亿深度，零滑点。这不是新闻——这是在打地基。但真正的肉在Unichain上。钩子合约0x2ea5eac8…一口气铺了九个池子，全是同一个b3fca863…代币。手续费8388608——动态费率嵌在钩子里。tick间距60。同一个钩子，同一个套路。有人在围着一个资产堆流动性，像在筑一个浓度层。第二个钩子0xbc6e5abd…又三个池子，也是WETH对，同款动态费率。在Unichain上，这不是测试——这是集群。另外，Unichain上有个ETH对ea7cb0eb…的池子，手续费100，tick间距1——最窄的区间。有人想几乎零价差交易。主网上还有个池子，钩子0x2877bf78…，零手续费，tick间距60，代币b44c4eca…对原生ETH。零手续费要么是钓鱼引套利者，要么是入口——收入不从池子手续费来。Hayden说可以把Phantom钱包的助记词导入Uniswap钱包，直接上Robinhood链。基础设施在合拢：Phantom用户进RH订单簿，Uniswap路由走PSM。这一切看着像在拼一个统一的流动性层，钩子不是实验——是齿轮。牌已铺好。

take.en: The house is building a unified liquidity machine, and the hooks are the cogs—watch the gears turn.
take.zh: 江湖在筑一个统一的流动性大阵，钩子就是阵眼——看齿轮怎么转。

narrative.en: Four new V4 pools dropped overnight, and that's not just scanner noise. The first one pairs a zero address with a token that looks like a junk contract, but hooks at 0x65c… betray a professional hand. Fee tier at 100, tick spacing at 1 — standard setup for an ETH pair, but someone chose to keep liquidity hidden for now. The second pool is more interesting: 0x1aba… paired with USDC, zero fee, tick spacing 1. Hooks at 0x8af… are no random drop. Zero fee on a stable pair usually means one thing: someone is ready to pay for volume, not spread. Either a test or a setup for something that will stir in the coming days. Two pools in the same block 25483556 — a rare event. Both with zero address, but one carries a fee of 8388608 (no typo, that's the dynamic fee flag), the other standard 100. Hooks at 0xd8e… and 0xd98… — contract names don't repeat, so different teams or different strategies. The first pool has tick spacing 60 — for volatile pairs; the second has spacing 1 — for tight ranges. The last pool again zero fee, but tick spacing 200. That's not for retail trading. That's for big moves, for whales who don't want to pay on every flip. Hooks at 0x225… and block 25483822, six blocks later than the others. The deck is being shuffled. Four pools, four different parameter sets, four hooks — and not a single repeated contract. Someone is clearly setting up a deal, but the suit isn't visible yet. Watching what appears first in these pools matters more than the pools themselves.
narrative.zh: 一夜之间，江湖上多了四个新的V4池子。第一个池子，零地址配一个看着像垃圾合约的代币，但钩子是0x65c…，出手就是老江湖的手笔。费率100，步长1，标准的ETH对配置，但有人故意不亮底牌，把流动性藏了起来。第二个池子更有看头：0x1aba…配USDC，零费率，步长1。钩子0x8af…不是随便丢的。零费率配稳定币，通常只意味着一件事：有人愿意为交易量买单，而不是吃价差。要么是试探，要么是未来几天要动手的伏笔。同一个区块25483556里出了两个池子，少见。都是零地址，但一个费率是8388608（不是笔误，这是动态费率的标记），另一个是标准的100。钩子分别是0xd8e…和0xd98…，合约名不重复，说明是不同门派或者不同路数。第一个池子步长60，适合波动大的对子；第二个步长1，适合窄幅区间。最后一个池子又是零费率，但步长200。这不是给散户玩的，是给大鳄准备的——他们不想每挪一步都交过路费。钩子是0x225…，区块25483822，比前面几个晚了六个区块。牌局在洗牌。四个池子，四套参数，四个钩子，没有重复的合约。有人在布阵，但阵眼还没亮。盯着这些池子里最先出现的流动性，比盯着池子本身重要。

take.en: The house is laying out four distinct hands with different hooks and parameters — the real play isn't the pools themselves, but the first liquidity that hits them.
take.zh: 四张牌已摊开，钩子不同、步法各异——真正的杀招不在池子本身，而在第一笔落进去的流动性。

narrative.en: The deal was laid on the felt yesterday, and it wasn't a single hand. Seven pools surfaced within minutes, each with a hook contract wired into its spine—no accidents here. Two pools paired the zero address against USDC: one with a fat tick spacing that whispers of wide-ranging liquidity, maybe for order-book mechanics; the other, tighter, with a different hook. Then a DAI/USDC pool, zero fee, unit tick spacing—this isn't for trading, it's a conversion bridge between stablecoins, slippage-free. A USDC/USDT pool followed, same parameters, different hook. Either competition or a coordinated spread across pairs. The real tell: three pools all using the same hook contract but with three different tick spacings—1, 10, 60—against the same counterparty. Someone is deploying a strategy, not just testing. And finally, a zero-address-against-USDT pool with zero fee—a rare beast indeed. Every hook is custom logic; every pool is a deliberate bet on how liquidity should behave. The house is watching, and the house knows these aren't random deals—they're the opening moves of a deeper game.
narrative.zh: 昨夜江湖暗流涌动，不是一两个池子，而是七道真气同时破土。零地址对USDC，两道池子：一道宽间距如大漠长风，似为做市机关蓄势；一道窄间距如银针探穴，钩子不同，各有玄机。DAI/USDC池，零费率，单位间距——这不是买卖，是两派内功的转换桥梁，无滑无震。USDC/USDT池，同样零费率，钩子却换了面孔。要么是两派较劲，要么是同门分路布局。最耐人寻味的是：同一个钩子，连出三池，间距分别为1、10、60——全对同一对手。这不是试招，这是布阵。最后，零地址对USDT，零费率，钩子暗藏。七池齐出，无一是闲棋。每个钩子都是独门心法，每个池子都是刻意为之。江湖老人看得出：这不是散兵游勇，是有人在搭台子，要唱一出大戏。

take.en: Seven pools in minutes, each with a tailored hook—this isn't noise, it's the sound of builders laying down infrastructure for a new liquidity architecture.
take.zh: 七池同出，钩法各异——这不是偶然，是有人在江湖深处布下一盘大棋。

narrative.en: The deal's been cut three times in twenty blocks. Two stable pairs—one against USDC, one against USDT—with identical micro-tick spacing and the same fee structure. That's not coincidence; that's a pattern. Someone's laying out a grid. The third pair breaks the mold: native ETH paired with a token I don't recognize, zero fee, wide tick spacing. No commission on the swap means the house takes its cut elsewhere—through the hook, not the trade. This isn't a token launch. This is deliberate architecture. The table's set, the chips are down. Someone's running a play they've rehearsed.
narrative.zh: 一夜之间，三座池子悄然落成，前后不过二十个区块。两座稳定币池——一座对USDC，一座对USDT——参数如出一辙：微步跳动，费率相同。这不是巧合，是有人在布阵。第三座池子却截然不同：原生ETH配一枚陌生代币，零费率，大步距。不收过路费，那必然另有生财之道——钩子才是真正的账房。这不是什么新币上线，是有人在精心搭台。江湖夜雨，暗流涌动。

take.en: Three pools in one night, two clones and one outlier—someone is building a coordinated strategy, not a random listing.
take.zh: 一夜三池，两同出一辙，一另辟蹊径——这不是随手上架，是有人在下一盘棋。

narrative.en: The deal on the table is pool ID 0xd222635befb0a5696744c0d68d2ad7fb047e72e64c47175f42260964779e4e5c — not just a hash, but a cut of the deck. Uniswap V4 hook pool at block 25462893 is no ordinary hand. Here the zero address plays against 0xd5dd59fc90431962c2b650069a85ac5d150f5154. Zero is always the wild joker, a suit without a suit. The second token is a specific hand, still unshown. The fee at 100 basis points is not for noise. It's a bet on fine-tuning liquidity. Tick spacing at 1 is the minimum step, as if you were cutting the deck one card at a time, not in stacks. Such spacing gives maximum flexibility but demands constant attention: every tick is a potential reversal. The hook contract 0xafe59bc5fe2073d3308e3acca77ecedf83528144 is the one shuffling the deck in real time. V4 without hooks is a dull table. With hooks, cards can change suits on the fly. Who wrote this hook, what conditions are encoded — still dark. But the very fact of its presence says someone is ready to play by their own rules. Notice: not a single public comment from the deployer. No teaser, no 'look at me'. This is either a cold-blooded player who knows the value of silence, or a test — but tests usually don't set fee at 100 and tick spacing at 1. Tests are wide spacing, round numbers. For now, this is just one deal. But such deals rarely lie dead. Either someone is preparing a new type of liquidity, or a hook will be written that flips the pool's logic. Waiting for the next cards from this deck.
narrative.zh: 这个池子ID 0xd222635befb0a5696744c0d68d2ad7fb047e72e64c47175f42260964779e4e5c，不是普通的哈希，是牌局里的一刀切。Uniswap V4的hook池，25462893区块，不是寻常的摊牌。零地址对0xd5dd59fc90431962c2b650069a85ac5d150f5154——零地址永远是百搭牌，无门无派。另一个代币是具体的招式，还没亮底。手续费100基点，不是闹着玩的。这是对流动性精细调校的下注。tick间距1，最小步长，好比一张张切牌，不是整叠。这种间距给最大灵活，但需要时刻盯着：每个tick都可能翻转。hook合约0xafe59bc5fe2073d3308e3acca77ecedf83528144，是当场洗牌的人。V4没有hook，就是一张空桌子。有hook，牌面能当场变。谁写的这个hook，藏了什么条件——现在还是黑的。但它的存在本身说明，有人要按自己的规矩玩。注意：部署者没发过一句公开消息。没有预告，没有'看我'。要么是冷血的玩家，知道沉默的分量；要么是测试——但测试不会设100基点和间距1。测试都是宽间距、整数。现在只是一手牌。但这种牌很少烂在桌上。要么有人在准备新类型的流动性，要么会有人写一个hook，把池子的逻辑翻过来。等这副牌的下一张。

take.en: A zero-address hook pool with 100 bp fee and tick spacing 1 is a deliberate setup — someone is dealing from a custom deck, not the house's.
take.zh: 零地址、100基点手续费、间距1——这不是随机发牌，是有人按自己的谱子下棋。

narrative.en: The deal is done, and a new hand begins on block 25455400. A Uniswap V4 pool with hooks is not just another liquidity pair—it's a bid for new mechanics. The pair: native ETH against contract 0x63ee...c0c0. And here's the kicker: that same address serves as the hooks. A closed loop—the contract services itself, audits itself. The fee of 8388608 is no mistake. In V4, that code means a dynamic or custom fee structure, not the standard 0.01%, 0.05%, or 0.30%. It's manual tuning, hinting at non-standard logic. Tick spacing 200—the step between ticks is wide, so the pool is built for volatile pairs or large orders where precision doesn't matter, but less gas on crossing. But the real card is the hooks contract itself. It is the token, it is the manager. That means every swap, every added or removed liquidity, passes through its filters. Whoever controls that contract controls the flow. And pool ID 0x9450...991—now a marker on the blockchain worth watching. No conclusions—only the fact: a new hand is on the felt. And its suit is yet unknown.
narrative.zh: 新的一局在区块 25455400 开启。Uniswap V4 带钩子的池子，不是普通的流动性——它是在争夺新的门派心法。对子：原生 ETH 对阵合约 0x63ee...c0c0。有意思的是，同一个地址就是钩子本身。自成一统——合约自己服务自己，自己审核自己。手续费 8388608 不是笔误。在 V4 里，这个代码代表动态或自定义收费结构，不是标准的 0.01%、0.05% 或 0.30%。这是手动调校，暗示着非常规的机关。Tick 间距 200——步宽大，说明这池子是为波动大的对子或大单准备的，精度不重要，但省 gas。真正的王牌是这个钩子合约。它既是代币，又是掌门。每一笔交换、每一次增减流动性，都得过它的关口。谁控制这合约，谁就控制了水流。池子 ID 0x9450...991——链上又多了一个值得留意的标记。不下定论——只摆事实：桌上多了一手新牌。花色未明。

take.en: Builders are deploying pools with non-standard swap fees—either zero or the maximum tier—instead of the usual market rates, signaling deliberate economic design where revenue is taken through the hook rather than the swap.
take.zh: 建设者们正在部署使用非标准 swap 费用的池子——要么是零，要么是最高档——而不是常见的市场费率。这表明了刻意的经济设计：收入通过钩子而非 swap 本身收取。
